node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 diagonal c2 (1,1,2) source-line q-slice resultant gate
node.closure: necessary degree-eight q-slice resultant identity for every reconstructed saturated source-line candidate
node.statement: For every saturated source-line diagonal (1,1,2) packet, put q=P_(J_1), let w be the forced-square quotient label, and let k_1,k_2 be the two remaining common-K labels carrying the four mixed stars. Every actual reconstructed candidate satisfies Res_T(q,U^2-WV^2) proportional to (W-w)^4((W-k_1)(W-k_2))^2. The target quadratic is tau^*q in the aligned branch and tau^*chi_Omega in the near-aligned branch. Failure rejects one finite candidate, but passing is not sufficient for either full colored quotient identity.
